Hymn 204: Silent Night
Time Signature: 6/8

This is hymn number 204 titled "Silent Night" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 6/8 time signature. 
The music was composed by Franz Gruber and the lyrics were written by Joseph Mohr.
